name: a-glossy-optimism-picnic
prompt: Worm's-eye view from down among the blades of a sunlit meadow, looking up a gentle rolling hill of brilliant, almost artificial emerald grass that fills the lower third of a tall portrait frame, the nearest blades sharp and glistening with dew, soft out-of-focus green at the very bottom edge. On the crest, on a red-and-white gingham blanket with a wicker hamper, a young mother, father and small daughter in fresh white and pastel clothes throw their heads back laughing, while a golden retriever is caught mid-leap above them, ears flying, all four paws off the ground. Fat iridescent soap bubbles drift across the whole frame, some large and close to the lens, each one catching swirls of magenta, cyan and gold on its skin. Above them an enormous, impossibly saturated cobalt sky deepening toward the top edge, with a few tidy cotton-ball cumulus clouds, and the midday sun just clipping the upper corner, throwing a bright starburst and a diagonal chain of soft hexagonal lens-flare ghosts down through the bubbles. Shot like a mid-2000s optimistic advertising photograph: wide-angle lens close to the ground, high clean daylight, crisp and glossy with a faint bloom on the highlights, punchy contrast, everything spotless and hopeful, the palette only sky blue, grass green, clean white and sunshine yellow. No text or lettering anywhere. Thanks.
